definition: The edge hands the ancestor's whole kit down: the descendant inherits its bindings for every slot and states only where it differs. Descent and regional edges carry the kit, and so does a co-parent where the kit genuinely blends.
basis: schema/style-node.schema.json, on an edge's slot list: "Absent means the edge carries the ancestor's whole kit", and on the kit flag: "If true, this edge participates in the kit-of-parts cascade. Only descends_from / regional_of edges should normally set this." docs/inheritance.md: "A child style inherits its parent's bindings and overrides selectively." docs/model.md: "Where the kit genuinely blends". README.md: "a style only needs to state what the cascade doesn't already give it for free".
